services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: You’ve experienced the rest, but have you joined the best? Our team members have been operating fishing trips & eco-excursions out of Rudee Inlet for over 40 years. With the largest fleet on the East Coast, departures year round, and our commitment to expertise, we’re where you want to be for everything to “see on the sea”! Book your experience of a wildlife watching adventure below ↓ A dolphin cruise with us is the essential trip for both the aquatic enthusiast and the fun-seeking vacationer! Come look for dolphins in Virginia Beach! If it’s fun, sun, speed, saltwater, and dolphins you’re looking for, the Rudee Rocket has it all! Join us for the most exciting boat ride in Virginia Beach!

services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Rates Adults (Ages 11 to 64) - $35 Senior (65+) / Military - $33 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $28 Kids 3 & Under - $5 Duration ~2 Hours Come experience an unforgettable trip to see incredible views of the world’s largest and most beautiful marine mammals. Our knowledgeable captain and crew will lead you on an educational journey along the Atlantic coast in search of whales, dolphins, seals, and several species of birds. The highlight of these trips is spotting humpback whales, which can often be seen breaching, flipper slapping or tail lobbing. services.name: Cocktail Cruise
services.desc: Rates Adults (21+ only) - $35 Duration 90 minutes Catch the spirit of the summer by joining us on a Cocktail Cruise featuring our local partner, Chesapeake Bay Distillery. Enjoy sunset over the water as you sip a selection of regional craft spirits on this unique adult-oriented trip. This is a 21 and over event. A valid photo ID is required at check in. What to Expect Dress for the weather! It will be slightly cooler out on the water. Layers and close-toed shoes with traction are recommended. Trips may be cancelled due to high winds creating unfavorable boating conditions, but will be conducted when it is raining. Departure is from Rudee Inlet at the Virginia Beach Fishing Center. services.name: Seal Spotting
services.desc: Duration 3 Hours Rates Adult: $37 Kid: $32 About Ready for a trip that gets a seal of approval? Look no further than an eco-excursion dedicated to viewing Virginia's sea puppies in their natural habitat: seal spotting! Our coastal waters host a variety of seal species, with harbor and gray seals being the most common sightings. What to Expect: Dress for the weather! It can be slightly cooler out on the water especially in the spring, fall, and winter. We may have to cancel trips due to high winds, but our cruises will still go when it is raining. services.name: Night Fishing
services.desc: Rates Adults - $40 Senior (65+) / Military - $38 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $30 Duration 3 Hours and 30 Minutes Fishing with our experts as the sun goes down is the perfect way to wind down your day! Join our experienced captain & crew as we head towards the Chesapeake Bay for a relaxing evening of fishing. For these family-friendly trips, we are mainly targeting croakers, spot, seatrout, roundhead, and small sharks. Our team on board is ready to help you every step of the trip to ensure that fisherfolks of all levels have a great time! services.name: Half-Day Fishing
services.desc: Rates Adults - $50 Senior (65+) / Military - $48 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $42 Duration 4 Hours Fishing fun for the whole family! Head towards the Chesapeake Bay with our experienced team fishing for croakers, seatrout (weakfish), roundhead, spot, and small sharks! This trip is perfect for anglers of all ages and experiences. What to Expect •Everything is furnished for your fishing needs – rod, reel, bait, tackle, fish bags & fishing license. Fish can be cleaned on board for a small fee. Departs from Rudee Inlet at the Virginia Beach Fishing Center. Please allow additional time for parking, which is free while you are on the trip and available on a first come, first served

services.name: Winter Wildlife Excursion
services.desc: Rates Adults (12 and Up!) - $60 Senior (65+) / Military - $58 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $55 Duration 4 Hours Join us for a unique exploration of the coast in search of a variety of marine mammals and seabirds! This is a trip you will not want to miss, as the Mid-Atlantic provides a critical habitat for many different species of animals. We will explore hot spots known for their exceptional sightings of birds and seals while experts on board provide information about the animals and current local research that is being conducted to better help protect them. •Our trip course will be determined by the concentration of recent sightings of our targeted species that include: harbor and gray seals,

services.name: 3/4 Day Fishing
services.desc: Rates Adults (Ages 12 and Up) - $80 Kids (Ages 4 to 11) - $70 Duration 6 Hours Get Into the Bite! Offered in in the spring & fall, these action-packed trips will ease you back into the fishing state of mind. In April & May, we target tautog. In September & October, we shift our focus primarily to black sea bass and triggerfish with occasional flounder and bluefish. What to Expect Everything is furnished for your fishing needs – rod, reel, bait, tackle, fish bags & fishing license. Fish can be cleaned on board for a small fee. services.name: 1/2-Day Whale Watch
services.desc: Rates Adults (12 and Up!) - $80 Duration ~5 Hours Ready for the ultimate whale adventure? Join our experts for an extended wildlife watching journey! During this ~5-hour trip, we will search for whales, dolphins, & seabirds that can be found in our coastal and near offshore waters. While we explore, we will be collecting data about the species we observe and their behaviors with researchers on board. •Our trip course will vary based upon current sightings, but may include various species of whales (humpback whales, fin whales, & minke whales), dolphins (bottlenose dolphins & common dolphins) and pelagic seabirds (northern gannets, various species of sea ducks, & razorbills). services.desc: Rates Adults (12 and Up!) - $165 Duration 13 Hours Experience the diversity the offshore waters off of the Mid-Atlantic have to offer as we head to the deep for our latest exploration! Norfolk Canyon, about 70 miles offshore, is a unique biological community teeming with wildlife. Join us as we head out to view the marine life that call this Mid-Atlantic Canyon home.
